name: Caipora
description: The Caipora is one of Brazil's most important forest guardian spirits, rooted in Indigenous Tupi-Guarani mythology, who protects wildlife from hunters who violate rules of fair-play and punishes those who disrespect the forest.
origin: Found throughout Brazil, with regional variations across the Amazon rainforest, Atlantic Coast, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, Minas Gerais, and Ceará. Also present in Argentine and Uruguayan folklore as a fire-breathing ghost variant.
